item.text:
<linkedin_post>OpenAI has retired much of the detailed style guidance in its updated Model Spec. The stated goal is to let models adapt their writing to users’ preferences, languages and cultures, using context and feedback as evidence.

Some defaults remain stronger than others. The Spec says models should approach questions objectively unless a user or developer asks for a particular perspective. A model should not assume that someone wants agreement simply because it predicts that agreement will be well received.

The update also adds guidance on social norms and human agency, and expands guidance on controlling and communicating side effects. OpenAI says the Spec describes the behavior it wants and that its models do not yet fully reflect it.</linkedin_post>
